status.summary: UFC women's strawweight champion per the ufcstats snapshot. She won the title bout over Virna Jandiroba by unanimous decision at UFC 321 (Oct 25, 2025, Abu Dhabi; 48-47, 48-47, 49-46) and defended it against Gillian Robertson at UFC 330 (Aug 15, 2026, Philadelphia; 49-46, 49-46, 48-47). The belt was open because Zhang Weili moved up to fight Valentina Shevchenko for the flyweight title (recalled; Zhang's Nov 15, 2025 flyweight title bout is in the dataset). The snapshot shows no bout after Aug 15, 2026. Her next booking, ranking and any injuries could not be checked on the web this session.

style.summary: A submission specialist who has made it work at the top of the division. Her striking is below average and her takedown entries rarely succeed, but once she is on top she holds position for long spells and hunts armbars and leg locks. Strikers who keep the fight standing have beaten her on volume, and Andrade knocked her out.

moves.notes: Weights follow the schema example and src/director.js: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1; spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for specials. Target split from fighters.json: time-decayed significant attempts are 85.9% head, 8.6% body, 5.4% legs (landed 73.0/15.3/11.8); career attempts 87.0/8.1/5.0; women's strawweight league 75.6/15.2/9.2. So she throws to the head more than the division does, and her leg strikes are few but accurate (11 of 11 vs Robertson, 13 of 13 vs Jandiroba, 11 of 11 vs Ribas in 2025). Some of these may be kicks thrown from the floor, but ufcstats does not say, so calf and inside are split evenly. Overhand gets a large share because her looping right hand is often described in coverage (recalled; no source could be opened this session). Body kicks lead the body group as a judgment. Knees and elbows are near zero: 7% of her decayed landed strikes are in the clinch, and her ground strikes are not split by technique. No web scouting source was read, so the within-group splits are judgments. Medium-low confidence.

Pace in 5-round fights (6 fights): 1.00, 0.70, 1.22, 1.06, 1.07 of round 1, against a division curve of 1.00, 0.88, 1.15, 1.21, 1.15. No late fade. She took R5 vs Jandiroba 35-23 with 11 of 11 ground strikes.
